action.task: Independently review processor.py (sha256 14158bfaa1ee46976df047364c7d5f12610496e12e0830b3f24ef3665a70c171) against SPEC.md requirements v1 (retry-v1). I read the candidate and SPEC, and the local check tool reported 6/6 passing public smoke checks: item validation (10 malformed items), applied/duplicate/conflict preserving original units, tenant-scoped identity, batch order/continuation/empty input, rollback after post-credit failure, and rollback after post-completion failure. Public checks are not exhaustive. Focus on: (1) whether validation of the whole item happens before any identity lookup; (2) whether duplicate/conflict paths leave the store unchanged, including returning from inside `with store.transaction()`; (3) transaction-boundary correctness for precommit failure injection (no effects persist) and post-commit acknowledgement loss (both effects persist, next identical delivery returns duplicate, including after reopening the DB and reloading the module); (4) exception propagation semantics in process_batch (stop on store error, earlier committed entries durable, later entries unprocessed); (5) empty-string/exactness rules and boolean exclusion, unbounded integer handling. Report concrete observed findings and whether any edit is warranted; do not treat HISTORY.json as live evidence.
